card.name: The start of diuretic
card.fires_on: The piece " di" that begins the word diuretic (as in diuretic therapy or diuretic dose), in drug-label warnings about kidney function, low volume or interactions.

modes.description: The opening piece of diuretic after 'on' in lists of at-risk patients.
